# Aswath Damodaran, historical returns on stocks, bonds and bills, 1928-2025 (January 2026 update), Wayback Machine capture

External reference, no bytes stored. Publisher: Aswath Damodaran, NYU Stern; capture by the Internet Archive. Source: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/datafile/histretSP.html.

The workbook histretSP.xls is free to download and is updated every January, so the live URL changes content once a year. The consumer downloads the Internet Archive capture of 2026-11-11 (identical bytes to the live file on 2026-11-22) and checks its SHA-256; no bytes are kept here. Sheet "Returns by year": annual total return of the S&P 500 with dividends, 3-month Treasury bill and 10-year Treasury bond, 1928-2025. Cite Damodaran, Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills: 1928-2025.
